info.title: SAAX Router
info.x-guidance: Use POST /route to request a capability. Returns a ranked supplier list with pricing. SAAX is a commitment layer: immediate x402 payments settle on Base mainnet via USDC and return a commitment ID; the MPP rail is implemented but not registered in production. An integrated escrow flow is tested on Base Sepolia only and is not available on mainnet; a Custody V3 candidate is tested only on a local EVM (chain 31337) and is not deployed. See /status for current status. Use GET /receipt to resolve a settled transaction back to a commitment ID.

post.summary: Request a capability and receive a ranked supplier list
post.description: Submit a capability request to the SAAX Router. The Router evaluates suppliers and returns a ranked list with pricing. Payment is required before the response is returned; the endpoint settles via x402 on Base mainnet.

get.summary: Resolve a settled transaction to a commitment ID
get.description: Reads the commitment store and returns the commitment linked to a settled on-chain transaction hash. Payer is the buyer record (an email address where one was recorded) and payee is the seller identifier from the terms; either may be null in a minimal record. A receipt confirms a settlement reference; it does not by itself prove the work was fulfilled or independently verify the lifecycle.

parameters.name: rail
parameters.description: Settlement rail (x402, mpp, ap2, acp, unspecified)

200.description: Receipt: commitment_id, rail, payer (nullable), payee (nullable), amount, settled_at

404.description: no settlement bound to this txHash
